layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Recent advances in text-to-image generation with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diffusion models present transformative capabil-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ities in image synthesis. However, user control-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lability of the generated image, and fast adapta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion to new tasks still remains an open challenge,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: currently mostly addressed by costly and long re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training and fine-tuning or ad-hoc adaptations to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: specific image generation tasks. In this work, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: present MultiDiffusion, a unified framework that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enables versatile and controllable image genera-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion, using a pre-trained text-to-image diffusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model, without any further training or finetuning

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: At the center of our approach is a new generation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: process, based on an optimization task that binds

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: together multiple diffusion generation processes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with a shared set of parameters or constraints. We

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: show that MultiDiffusion can be readily applied

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to generate high quality and diverse images that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adhere to user-provided controls, such as desired

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: aspect ratio (e.g., panorama), and spatial guiding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: signals, ranging from tight segmentation masks to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bounding boxes.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Text-to-image generative models have emerged as a “disrup-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tive technology", demonstrating unprecedented capabilities

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in synthesizing high-quality and diverse images from text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompts, where diffusion models are currently established as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: state-of-the-art (Saharia et al., 2022b; Ramesh et al., 2022;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Rombach et al., 2022; Croitoru et al., 2022). While this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: progress holds a great promise in changing the way we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can create digital content, deploying text-to-image models

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to real-world applications remains challenging due to the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: difficulty to provide users with intuitive control over the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generated content. Currently, controllability over diffusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models is achieved in one of two ways: (i) training a model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from scratch or finetuning a given diffusion model for the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: task at hand (e.g., inpainting, layout-to-image training, etc.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (Wang et al., 2022a; Ramesh et al., 2022; Rombach et al.,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2022; Nichol et al., 2021; Avrahami et al., 2022b; Brooks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al., 2022; Wang et al., 2022b)). With the ever-increasing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scale of models and training data, this approach often re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quires extensive compute and long development period, even

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in a finetuning setting. (ii) Reuse a pre-trained model and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: add some controlled generation capability. Previously, these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods have concentrated on specific tasks and designed a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tailored methodology (e.g., replacing objects in an image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: manipulating style, or controlling layout (Tumanyan et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2022; Hertz et al., 2022; Avrahami et al., 2022a)).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The goal of this work is to design MultiDiffusion, a new

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unified framework that significantly increases the flexibil-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity in adapting a pre-trained (reference) diffusion model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to controlled image generation. The basic idea behind the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: MultiDiffusion is to define a new generation process that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is composed of several reference diffusion generation pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cesses binded together with a set of shared parameters or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: constraints. In more detail, the reference diffusion model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is applied to different regions in the generated image, pre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dicting a denoising sampling step for each. In turn, the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: MultiDiffusion takes a global denoising sampling step rec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: onciling all these different steps via least squares optimal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: solution.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: For example, consider the task of generating an image at ar-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bitrary aspect ratio given a reference diffusion model trained

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on square images (Fig. 2). At each denoising step, the Mul-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tiDiffusion fuses the denoising directions, provided by the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reference model, from all the square crops, and strives to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: follow them all as closely as possible, constrained by the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fact that nearby crops share common pixels. Intuitively,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we encourage each crop to be a real sample from the ref-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: erence model. Note that while each crop might pull to a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: different denoising direction, our framework yields a unified

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: denoising step, hence produces high-quality and seamless

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: With MultiDiffusion, we are able to harness a reference

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pre-trained text-to-image to different applications including

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: synthesizing images at desired resolution or aspect ratio, or

layout_dets.text: 5.1. Panorama Generation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To evaluate our method on the task of text-to-panorama gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Since there is no direct method for generating images at arbi-

layout_dets.text: baselines: (i) Blended Latent Diffusion (BLD) (Avrahami

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al., 2022)), and Stable Inpainting (SI) (Rombach et al.,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2022), which has been finetuned on large-scale data for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: inpainting. For both baselines, the panoramic image is gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: erated gradually, starting from a central image (sampled by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Φ given the input text), and extrapolated progressively to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the right and left.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fig. 4 shows sample generation results by our method com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: exhibit visible seams and discontinuities between overlap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ping crops, as well as degradation in visual quality as mov-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing away from the center pivotal image; this is expected

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: due to the iterative generation process. BLD often generates

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: repetitive content (e.g., skiers example), where SI results in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: noticeable visual difference between the left and right parts

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the image. In contrast, our framework simultaneously

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: paths of all crops, resulting in seamless and high quality

layout_dets.text: 6. Discussion and Conclusions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Controllable generation is one of the major pending chal-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lenges with text-to-image diffusion models. We proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to tackle this challenge from a fundamentally new direction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: – defining a new generation process on top of a pre-trained

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and fixed diffusion model. This approach has several key

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: advantages over previous works: (i) it does not require any

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: further training or finetuning, (ii) it can be applied to various

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: different generation tasks, and (iii) our generation process

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: yields an optimization task which can be solved in closed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: form for many tasks, hence can be computed efficiently,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: while ensuring convergence to the global optimum of our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: objective. As for limitations, our method heavily relies on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the generative prior of the reference diffusion model, i.e.,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the quality of our results depends on the diffusion paths pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vided by the model. Thus, when a "bad" path is chosen by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the reference model (e.g., bad seed, or biased text-prompt),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our results will be affected as well. In some cases, we can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mitigate it by introducing more constraints into our frame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work (bootstrapping in Sec. 4.2), or prompt-engineering

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (Fig. 9). We thoroughly evaluated our framework, demon-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strating state-of-the-art results even compared to methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that are tailored-trained for specific tasks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We believe that our work can trigger further future research

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in harnessing the power of a pre-trained diffusion model in

layout_dets.text: D. Societal Impact

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our primary goal in this work is to enable novice users to generate visual content in a more intuitive and flexible way.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, it is prone to societal biases the underlying text-based generative model inherits from its training data (Birhane

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al., 2021). There is a risk of misuse for creating fake or harmful content with our technology, and we believe that it is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: crucial to conduct further research on identifying synthetic content and to develop tools for detecting and addressing biases

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and malicious use cases.
